name: June
title: Where to go on holiday in June
intro: June has long, warm days without the full heat and prices of the school holidays. It's the best month of the year for more of our guides than almost any other.
seo_title: Where is hot in June? Summer sun and where to go

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
June is the start of summer, and the whole of southern Europe is hot. The Greek islands, southern Turkey, Spain and Cyprus are around 28 to 31°C, and even Paris, Berlin and Amsterdam are in the low twenties. The sea has warmed up, to around 22 to 24°C in most of the Mediterranean, and the days are the longest of the year.

Before the school holidays start in July, prices are lower and resorts are quieter than they'll be until September. For many people, that makes June the best month of the summer.

The temperatures below are average daytime highs for June, rounded. Flight times are typical direct flights from London. Everywhere at its best in June is listed above.

sections.heading: The ranking at a glance
sections.text:
The hottest beach places within about five hours of the UK:

- **1. [Antalya](/destinations/antalya) and [Kaş](/destinations/kas):** around 31°C. About 4 hours.
- **2. [Rhodes](/destinations/rhodes), [Corfu](/destinations/corfu) and [Paphos](/destinations/paphos):** around 29°C. 3 hours to 4 hours 30 minutes.
- **3. [Málaga](/destinations/malaga):** around 29°C. About 2 hours 45 minutes.
- **4. [Crete](/destinations/crete), [Mallorca](/destinations/mallorca), [Malta](/destinations/malta), [Split](/destinations/split) and [Puglia](/destinations/puglia):** around 28°C. 2 hours 15 minutes to 4 hours.
- **5. [Santorini](/destinations/santorini), [Dubrovnik](/destinations/dubrovnik), the [Algarve](/destinations/algarve) and [Ibiza](/destinations/ibiza):** around 27°C. 2 to 4 hours.
- **6. [Menorca](/destinations/menorca), [Corsica](/destinations/corsica) and [Naxos](/destinations/naxos):** around 26°C, a little less hot. 2 to 4 hours.

Inland, [Seville](/destinations/seville), [Marrakech](/destinations/marrakech) and [Jordan](/destinations/jordan) are already 31 to 33°C, too hot for most people to enjoy sightseeing.

sections.heading: Beach holidays before the school holidays
sections.text:
June is a great month for a beach holiday, especially in the first three weeks, before the schools in England and Wales break up.

- **Greece:** [Crete](/destinations/crete), [Rhodes](/destinations/rhodes), [Kefalonia](/destinations/kefalonia), [Milos](/destinations/milos) and [Naxos](/destinations/naxos) are hot and sunny, with the sea around 23°C.
- **Turkey:** [Antalya](/destinations/antalya), [Bodrum](/destinations/bodrum) and [Kaş](/destinations/kas) are among the hottest places in the Mediterranean.
- **Spain:** [Mallorca](/destinations/mallorca), [Menorca](/destinations/menorca) and [Ibiza](/destinations/ibiza) are at their best before the July and August crowds.
- **Italy and Croatia:** [Puglia](/destinations/puglia), [Sicily](/destinations/sicily-road-trip), [Split](/destinations/split) and the [Amalfi Coast](/destinations/amalfi-coast) are hot and sunny.

Scotland's schools break up at the end of June, so prices rise earlier for flights from Scottish airports. Our [beach holidays](/destinations/beach-holidays) page has more.

sections.heading: Cooler places for June
sections.text:
If you'd rather not be in the heat, June is the best month for northern Europe.

- **Scandinavia:** [Stockholm](/destinations/stockholm), [Copenhagen](/destinations/copenhagen) and the [Norwegian fjords](/destinations/norwegian-fjords) are around 17 to 20°C, with almost endless daylight around midsummer.
- **Iceland:** the [Ring Road](/destinations/iceland-ring-road) is open, and the midnight sun means you can drive late into the evening.
- **The Alps and the lakes:** [Interlaken](/destinations/interlaken), [Hallstatt](/destinations/hallstatt) and [Lake Bled](/destinations/lake-bled) are green, warm and great for walking.
- **The Baltics:** [Riga](/destinations/riga) and [Tallinn](/destinations/tallinn) are around 19 to 21°C and celebrate midsummer in style.

sections.heading: Long-haul in June
sections.text:
- **Indonesia:** [Bali](/destinations/bali) and [Lombok](/destinations/lombok) are in their dry season, around 30 to 31°C.
- **East Africa:** [Zanzibar](/destinations/zanzibar) is coming out of the rains, and safari season is starting in East and southern Africa.
- **North America:** [New York](/destinations/new-york), [Chicago](/destinations/chicago), [Boston](/destinations/boston), [Toronto](/destinations/toronto) and [Montreal](/destinations/montreal) are all warm without the August humidity, and [Banff](/destinations/banff) and [Vancouver](/destinations/vancouver) are green and fresh.

The Caribbean, Mexico and Thailand are in their rainy and hot season, with lower prices but heavy showers.

sections.heading: How to choose
sections.text:
For hot, reliable beach weather, go east: Greece, Turkey and Cyprus are the hottest. For warm but not baking, the Balearics, Croatia and the Algarve are ideal. To get away from the heat altogether, June is the best month of the year for Scandinavia, Iceland and the Alps.

If you're choosing as a family or group and everyone wants something different, put a few of these on a shortlist and let everyone vote with points. That's what somewhere🎉 is for, and our guide to [deciding where to go on holiday](/how-to-decide-where-to-go-on-holiday) explains how it works.

faqs.question: Where is hot in June?
faqs.answer: The Greek islands (Crete, Naxos, Milos, Kefalonia), Menorca, Corsica, Puglia, Croatia and the Turkish coast are hot and sunny, but not yet at their busiest.

faqs.question: Where can we go in June that isn't too hot?
faqs.answer: Try the north: Bergen and the Lofoten Islands, Reykjavik, the Faroe Islands, the Azores and Asturias are mild, green and light until late. In Canada, Banff and Vancouver are lovely.

faqs.question: Is June a good time to visit North America?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most of the US and Canada is warm without being sweltering, and the national parks like Yellowstone and Banff open up fully. Montreal, Quebec City and Toronto have their summer festivals.

faqs.question: Where is the hottest place in Europe in June?
faqs.answer: Southern Spain and southern Turkey. Seville averages around 33°C, and Antalya around 31°C. Inland, central Spain and Greece are also very hot.

faqs.question: Is June a good time to go to Greece?
faqs.answer: Yes. It's hot and sunny, around 28 to 29°C on the islands, the sea has warmed up, and it's cheaper and quieter than July and August.

faqs.question: Where is warm but not too hot in June?
faqs.answer: The Algarve, the Balearics and Croatia are around 26 to 28°C. For cooler weather, Paris, Amsterdam and Prague are around 20 to 23°C, and Scandinavia around 17 to 20°C.
